kind: AI-generated marketing artwork using actual client captures as visual references

items.name: apps
items.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished WANX installer onboarding poster, wide landscape 16:9. A polished premium Chinese technology product campaign, unified warm ivory background (#FCF9F5), terracotta typography (#A35D40), soft tactile materials, gentle studio daylight, generous whitespace, elegant editorial hierarchy. This belongs to a coherent three-poster series for WANX modules 应用 / 空间 / 盒子. Use the provided real product screenshot as a supporting product-screen reference/insert: retain the actual WANX logo, navigation, layout and interface details faithfully; do not invent product features, numbers, controls or new UI. Surround the real screen with tasteful sculptural visual metaphors; the poster itself is marketing artwork, not a supposed real screenshot. Keep text sparse and large enough to read when downscaled to an installer panel. No Apple logo, no fake testimonials, no QR codes, no pricing, no personal names, no IP addresses, no watermarks. Keep all important content inside an 8 percent safe margin. Primary headline on left, product-screen composition on right, visually balanced.
Poster 1 of 3, module 应用. Main text verbatim: "应用". Secondary text verbatim: "让 AI 融入日常". Small footer text verbatim: "WANX · 万象". Hero: a beautiful curated constellation of rounded app tiles with warm terracotta, amber gold, jade and teal accents, with the actual WANX applications screen displayed prominently in a refined floating front-facing panel. Express discovering and using AI tools in one home. Use the distinctive app icon silhouettes/colors from the real screenshot, avoid generic robot heads. Warm cream and terracotta dominate; subtle gold highlights.
